quest.title: King of Invokations
quest.description: While in Sumeru, you bump into a novelist looking for inspiration.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Traveler! Nice to see you again. Thanks to your help last time, Asagiri went smoothly with her illustrations.

choices.text: Glad I could help.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Yes, the researchers are still going over the finer details of production at the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Some have said that, since it's a new edition, the resource system should be innovative to ensure an experience that encourages creativity.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Some said more budget should be spent on hiring artists as attractive card designs are crucial to the card game.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: And someone went even further, expecting a battle among all the researchers involved in the creation of Genius Invokation TCG.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: The winner gets a greater say in it. Well, I think it's just their excuse for playing Genius Invokation TCG.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: I could hardly understand anything that they were talking about, so I left saying I needed some inspiration.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Could you model for me again, Traveler?

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: I'm not asking for anything special this time. Just a quick showcase of your battle skills will do.

choices.text: I thought you were writing a card game novel?

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Well, just so you know, there's not much of a market for plain card games now.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Honestly, I think fighting in a card game is getting a bit tacky. I'm now devising a plot where my characters play cards while racing on horses.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: But I haven't decided on the reason they do that... So I guess I'll start with the scene where they turn a card game into a fight.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: I've found a nice spot for the setting. Let's get going then.

choices.text: What does card game have to do with battle skills?
Are you still looking for inspiration today?

talks.objective: Go to the spot to take photos

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: This is the place! Look, there's a handful of Slimes over there.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Traveler, please beat them in the way you think is the most impressive!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you sure it'll be applied in the card game novel?

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Of course! It's true that playing cards can fix most of the problems in my novel.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: But there will always be things that cannot be solved by playing cards, and the characters will need to rely on some "realistic" tactics.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you, Traveler. I'll be waiting here.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Excellent! This picture must be enough for Asagiri to draw a few more.

choices.text: I want to play Genius Invokation TCG.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Hahaha... I'll convey this to the researchers.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: But the researchers' work seems to be going so well that they can now make light of their discussions.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Unlike at the very beginning, well... when they argued for days on end...

choices.text: I'm excited about Genius Invokation TCG.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Darn it. Those Sumeru people made me feel so cheated!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did someone cheat you out of your money?

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Wah, you... you scared me!

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: *sigh* I didn't lose money, but they did trick me into coming to Sumeru...

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Oh, let me introduce myself first... My name is Fukumoto, a novelist from Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You say you were cheated?

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Well, it's a long story... Have you heard of Genius Invokation, the card game created by the Akademiya?

choices.text: G—Genius Invokation?

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: You didn't know that? I'm surprised. Haven't you heard of that book I wrote, "King of Invokations"? It's one of the best sellers in Yae Publishing House!

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Uh... you didn't know that either? It's... It's alright. It doesn't matter!

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: In short, some guys in the Sumeru Akademiya invented a card game named Genius Invokation TCG.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: To promote the game, they asked me through Yae Publishing House to write a light novel based on its rules.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: However, those researchers haven't figured out the game rules themselves. Besides, our communication is far from efficient given the long distance between Sumeru and Inazuma. So I've been having a tough time writing...

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Fortunately, I got to finish the novel with the support of Yae Publishing House. The book sold well, and it drove the sales of Genius Invokation TCG as planned.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: And here's the point... the researchers said they would rewrite the rules for Genius Invokation TCG and roll out a new version of the game.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: They asked me to write a sequel based on the new game, and invited me to the Sumeru Akademiya for a face-to-face meeting.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: I came all the way from Inazuma to Sumeru, only to hear from the researchers that... the rules of the new version of Genius Invokation TCG have yet to be determined! They have asked me to stay in Sumeru for the time being.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: They meant to apologize, and introduce me to some big names in the Akademiya as the inspirations for my book, including Cyno, and Tighnari...

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: At first I was a little upset, but the researchers... every one of them looked like they hadn't gotten a single night's sleep in a long time. The one who was supposed to greet me could barely stand...

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: *sigh* So I gave it some thought. Since I haven't even finished working on the outline for my book, I should be able to wait a little longer. I agreed to stay in Sumeru until the new rules are finalized.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Thus, this is what I've come for today.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Traveler, could you do me a favor?

choices.text: Only if you tell me what it is...

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Here's the thing. To make the novel more appealing, I went out of my way and asked Asagiri to draw illustrations for it.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: I've decided on several key plots for illustrations. But in addition to written descriptions, I also need to give Asagiri some pose references.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: But with my limited experience in fighting, the poses I struck all looked weak and lacked spirit.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Traveler, I bet you're a battle-hardened veteran. Can you model for me? See, I even borrowed a Kamera...

choices.text: Alright...

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: I appreciate that, Traveler. I've found a nice spot. Let's head there!

choices.text: Make sure I look good.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: No problem. Trust me on that!

choices.text: I'm not very good at playing cards...
Card game?

talks.objective: Go to the spot to take photos

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: This is the place. Let me see... Well, first I need...

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: A pose when the character finds themselves in trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's not clear at all. Paimon has no idea what kind of pose to make!

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Umm... Just go with your instinct.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Now Traveler, what will you do when you find yourself in trouble?

choices.text: Well, I'll fight.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Impressive answer! So the first thing you do in the face of trouble is to fight... then please strike an imposing fighting stance!

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Just like... you are ready to fight against the difficulties ahead.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: This fight is what it takes to survive! Your only choice to live!

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Ahem! Actually, these are the lines I designed for my character... Anyway, just try to imagine the situation and pose.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm... Paimon doubts the character would actually say things like that...

choices.text: I won't get myself into trouble.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: What a proud answer! Just like one of my characters!

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Then please strike a proud pose!

talks.objective: Go to the spot and strike a pose

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Nice job! These pictures should be enough for Asagiri. I guess the illustration thing is settled then...

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. Please take this as your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: I must return to the Akademiya and find a way to send these pictures back to Asagiri.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: I heard that Asagiri has been getting a lot of appointments recently. Haha, guess I'll have to grab myself a slot before her schedule's full.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Hmm, this one is pretty good, so is that one...

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: *sigh* Are these researchers actually okay?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong with the researchers?

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: *sigh* Don't get me started. It's about Genius Invokation TCG, of course. Judging from how hard the researchers are working, I'm worried that they'll have ground themselves to dust by the time the new rules are finished.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Still, they seem to have worked out the general idea for the rules of the game. I finally have something to work with.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: I don't quite understand the nature of their work... All I can do is trust that they'll do their best.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: As for me? I've still got some work to do on the illustrations.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Thanks to your help last time, Asagiri has produced some pretty nice illustrations.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, Traveler, could you be my model again?

choices.text: Alright...

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Thanks a lot. I will take care of the payment.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: I've found a nice spot. It's not far away.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Alright, lemme pack up my Kamera and then we can head out!

choices.text: Didn't they introduce you to any big names?

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Well... they said they were trying, but it seems that Cyno and Tighnari are too busy to model for now.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: But I heard Cyno is a master in Genius Invokation TCG!

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: If I can get him to strike a dashing pose at the table with cards in hand...

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Forget it. We'd better be realistic.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Thank you for being my model, Traveler. I'll be sure to compensate you!

choices.text: You can never gather enough inspiration, can you?

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Well, it's not like I get to visit Sumeru whenever I want. Of course, I gotta make the most of my stay here.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Which, by the way, can also give me a break from my editor... Ahem!

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Oh, don't mention it. This matter concerns none other than Genius Invokation TCG. Didn't that group of researchers work tirelessly to flesh out the rules of Genius Invokation TCG?

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: I thought they could take a breather this time... But I didn't think that they'd begin studying again. They said something about continuing planning subsequent designs...

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: I don't quite understand the nature of their work... All I can do is trust that they'll do their best.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto

response.speaker: Fukumoto

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Traveler! Nice to see you again. Thanks to your help last time, Asagiri went smoothly with her illustrations.

choices.text: Glad I could help.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: That's right. To novelists like me, more material could never hurt!

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Sumeru is such an interesting place as well — I can't say I lack for new things to see, even now.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: If it wasn't for Asagiri's fragile constitution, I would have asked her to come to Sumeru to gather inspiration as well.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Ahem. Anyway, let's talk business... Could you model for me again, Traveler?

response.speaker: Fukumoto

choices.text: Aren't you writing a card game novel?

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Well, just so you know, there's not much of a market for plain card games now.

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: Honestly, even I think that fighting via card games is getting a bit tacky by this point. I'm now devising a plot where my characters play cards while racing on horses!

response.speaker: Fukumoto
response.text: But I haven't decided on the reason why they might even do that in the first place... So I guess I'll just have to start with a scene where a card game turns into a battle.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Excellent! This picture must be enough for Asagiri to draw a few more.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. Please, take these as your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Fukumoto
dialogues.text: Once I finish my work... Well, perhaps we can have a little "duel" then!
